title: Responding to Harbor's 20 percent price cut
variant: Urgent: warning strip on top, stat tiles, a compact option table
prompt: Brief the leadership team on how to respond to our main competitor cutting prices 20% last week.
note: Urgent by design: the bottom line is a warning-toned strip across the top of the page before the title, the key facts are four stat tiles in a row so the money is visible before a word of context, and the options are a compact table with the recommended row highlighted rather than cards, because the reader is a leadership team deciding by Friday. All sans and tighter, with the open questions as a checklist carrying an owner and a day each so the page doubles as the meeting's action list.
